spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card
spec.vuln_cue: says they're already behind on a couple of bills

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Carys Ellingham. I’ve lost my debit card and need a replacement.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry to hear that. I can help with that. Before we discuss anything on your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. When did you last have the card?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yesterday afternoon, I think. I’ve checked everywhere, so I’d like to get it stopped and replaced.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll block the lost card so it can’t be used, then arrange a replacement to be sent to your address. It usually arrives within five to seven working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s fine. I’m already behind on a couple of bills, so I’m a bit worried about anything else going wrong.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve got that to deal with, Carys. We can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, who can talk through your circumstances, or I can explain how to ask a bill provider for extra time. Would either be helpful?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Maybe the Financial Support team, please. I’m not unhappy with the bank or anything; I’ve just had a tight month.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Absolutely, and thanks for clarifying. I can give you their number, or arrange for them to contact you. I can’t say what support may be available until they’ve spoken with you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Could you give me the number?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Certainly. It’s 0800 555 0148. For your card, I’ll block the lost one now and order the replacement to 22 Willow Lane; you’ll need to use your PIN when the new card arrives to activate it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, to summarise, the old card will be blocked and a replacement sent out, usually within five to seven working days. You’ve also got the Financial Support team’s number if you want to discuss the bills. Does that all make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that’s clear. Thanks for your help.
